Definition: {to end (in the sense of completion or failure)}
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, gᵉmar means to complete. It occurs just once, in Ezra.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: gᵉmar means to complete, and I do not stretch it further.
